scanNote:
WORKBOOK 13-UNITNING IKKINChI BETI (55-bet, PDF 53). Yuqorida o'ngda 'Join in the Fun!' va to'q sariq '13'.

CHAP USTUN - 'Grammar':
7) 'Match the items in column A to those in column B to make correct sentences.' A: 1 Mum won't let, 2 Sheila agreed, 3 Mark couldn't help, 4 You must, 5 Please remember, 6 Tom has decided, 7 They were looking, 8 Brenda loves | B: a visit the Taj Mahal while you're in India. b us watch the horror film. c painting pictures. d to give up smoking. e to lock the door. f to help her sister with her homework. g forward to going to the dance. h laughing at the funny man.
8a) 'Make sentences using the information from the chart below, as in the examples.' Qiya: 'Andy would like to go to the cinema. He enjoys eating pizza.' JADVAL: would like: Andy - go cinema; Julie - learn French; The Smiths - travel more. enjoy: eat pizza; meet people; read books. not like: tidy room; play chess; sing. can't stand: study maths; dance; watch TV. 8b) 'Make sentences about yourself, using would like, enjoy, not like and can't stand.'

O'NG USTUN:
9) 'Fill in the gaps with the verbs from the list in their correct form. Use each verb twice.' Qiya: 'buy, ask, write'. 1 I must remember ...... a letter to my aunt. 2 I don't remember ...... that note. 3 I'll never forget ...... my first CD. 4 Don't forget ...... milk on your way home. 5 They stopped ...... the policeman for directions. 6 Please stop ...... so many questions!
10) 'Fill in the gaps with one of the verbs from the list in the correct form.' Qiya: 'work, get, eat, go, speak, look'. KOLLAJ (odamlar suratlari, pufaklar): 1 (keksa juftlik) 'Our son has decided ...... married.' 2 (bola) 'I'm really looking forward to ...... this.' 3 (qulog'iga qo'l qo'ygan ayol) 'Could you ...... a bit louder, please?' 4 (fotoapparatli erkak) 'Would you ...... at the camera, please?' 5 (uyqusiragan ayol) 'I would love ...... to bed now.' 6 (galstugini bo'shatayotgan erkak) 'I can't stand ...... in this heat.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '55'.

exercises.instructionEn: Match the items in column A to those in column B to make correct sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: A ustundagi bandlarni B ustundagilarga moslab to'g'ri gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
INFINITIV / -ING (coursebook
  94-bet qoidasi).

  LET + kishi + FE'L (to siz):
    'won't let us watch'
  AGREE + TO + fe'l: 'agreed to
    help'
  CAN'T HELP + V-ING: 'couldn't
    help laughing'
  MUST + FE'L (to siz): 'must
    visit'
  REMEMBER + TO + fe'l: 'remember
    to lock'
  DECIDE + TO + fe'l: 'decided to
    give up'
  LOOK FORWARD TO + V-ING: 'looking
    forward to going'
  LOVE + V-ING: 'loves painting'

  1 → b, 2 → f, 3 → h, 4 → a,
  5 → e, 6 → d, 7 → g, 8 → c


⚠ 'CAN'T HELP + V-ING':

  = o'zini tiya olmaslik.
  'couldn't help laughing' =
  kulishdan o'zini tiyolmadi.


⚠ 'TO GIVE UP':

  = tashlamoq (odat).


⚠ 'THE TAJ MAHAL':

  = Toj Mahal (Hindiston).

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences using the information from the chart below, as in the examples. Andy: would like - go cinema; enjoy - eat pizza; not like - tidy room; can't stand - study maths. Julie: learn French; meet people; play chess; dance. The Smiths: travel more; read books; sing; watch TV. Examples: Andy would like to go to the cinema. He enjoys eating pizza.
exercises.instructionUz: Quyidagi jadvaldagi ma'lumot bilan gaplar tuzing, namunalardagidek. Andy: would like - go cinema; enjoy - eat pizza; not like - tidy room; can't stand - study maths. Julie: learn French; meet people; play chess; dance. The Smiths: travel more; read books; sing; watch TV. Namunalar: Endi kinoga borishni xohlardi. U pitsa yeyishdan zavqlanadi.
exercises.explanationUz:
WOULD LIKE + TO / ENJOY + -ING /
  NOT LIKE + -ING / CAN'T STAND +
  -ING.

  would like TO go
  enjoyS eatING
  doesn't like tidyING
  can't stand studyING

  ⚠ 'The Smiths' = ko'plik → 'they':
  'enjoy', 'don't like'.


⚠ 'CAN'T STAND':

  = toqat qilolmaslik, umuman
  yoqtirmaslik.
exercises.exampleEn: Andy would like to go to the cinema. He enjoys eating pizza.
exercises.exampleUz: Endi kinoga borishni xohlardi. U pitsa yeyishdan zavqlanadi.
modelAnswers: Andy doesn't like tidying his room. He can't stand studying maths.
Julie would like to learn French. She enjoys meeting people. She doesn't like playing chess. She can't stand dancing.
The Smiths would like to travel more. They enjoy reading books. They don't like singing. They can't stand watching TV.
modelAnswersUz: Endi xonasini yig'ishtirishni yoqtirmaydi. U matematika o'qishga toqat qilolmaydi.
Juli fransuz tilini o'rganishni xohlardi. U odamlar bilan tanishishdan zavqlanadi. U shaxmat o'ynashni yoqtirmaydi. U raqsga toqat qilolmaydi.
Smitlar ko'proq sayohat qilishni xohlashardi. Ular kitob o'qishdan zavqlanishadi. Ular qo'shiq aytishni yoqtirishmaydi. Ular televizor ko'rishga toqat qilolmaydilar.

exercises.instructionEn: Make sentences about yourself, using would like, enjoy, not like and can't stand.
exercises.instructionUz: O'zingiz haqingizda would like, enjoy, not like va can't stand bilan gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
O'Z JAVOBINGIZ.
  would like TO + fe'l
  enjoy / don't like / can't stand
  + V-ING.
exercises.exampleEn: I would like to visit London. I enjoy playing football.
exercises.exampleUz: Londonga borishni xohlardim. Futbol o'ynashdan zavqlanaman.
modelAnswers: I would like to visit London.
I enjoy playing football with my friends.
I don't like getting up early.
I can't stand waiting in queues.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the verbs from the list in their correct form. Use each verb twice: buy, ask, write.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring. Har bir fe'lni ikki marta ishlating: buy, ask, write.
exercises.explanationUz:
REMEMBER / FORGET / STOP - IKKI
  MA'NO (coursebook 95-bet).

  remember/forget + TO + fe'l =
    KELAJAKDAGI ishni eslamoq/
    unutmoq (vazifa):
    'remember to write', 'don't
    forget to buy'
  remember/forget + V-ING =
    O'TGAN ishni eslamoq/unutmoq
    (xotira):
    'don't remember writing', 'never
    forget buying'

  stop + TO + fe'l = biror ish
    QILISh UChUN to'xtamoq:
    'stopped to ask the policeman'
  stop + V-ING = ishni TO'XTATMOQ:
    'stop asking questions'


⚠ FARQ:

  'I stopped to ask' = so'rash
  uchun to'xtadim.
  'Stop asking!' = so'rashni bas
  qil!

exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi fe'llardan birining to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring: work, get, eat, go, speak, look. 1 Our son has decided ___ married. 2 I'm really looking forward to ___ this. 3 Could you ___ a bit louder, please? 4 Would you ___ at the camera, please? 5 I would love ___ to bed now. 6 I can't stand ___ in this heat.
exercises.explanationUz:
INFINITIV / -ING / ODDIY ShAKL.

  decide TO get married
  look forward to eatING (V-ing!)
  Could you SPEAK (modal - to siz)
  Would you LOOK (modal - to siz)
  would love TO go
  can't stand workING


⚠ 'TO GET MARRIED':

  = uylanmoq / turmushga chiqmoq.


⚠ 'LOOK FORWARD TO' + V-ING:

  'to' predlog, shuning uchun
  V-ING ('to eat' EMAS).


⚠ 'A BIT LOUDER':

  = biroz balandroq.


⚠ 'IN THIS HEAT':

  = bu issiqda.

patterns.formula: X would like / decided / agreed to + FE'L.
patterns.exampleEn: Tom has decided to give up smoking.

patterns.formula: X enjoys / loves / can't stand / doesn't like + V-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: Andy enjoys eating pizza. He can't stand studying maths.
patterns.exampleUz: Endi pitsa yeyishdan zavqlanadi. U matematika o'qishga toqat qilolmaydi.

patterns.exampleEn: Don't forget to buy milk. / I'll never forget buying my first CD.
patterns.exampleUz: Sut olishni unutma. / Birinchi CD sotib olganimni hech unutmayman.

patterns.exampleEn: They stopped to ask for directions. / Stop asking questions!
patterns.exampleUz: Ular yo'l so'rash uchun to'xtashdi. / Savol berishni bas qil!
